extra.final_summary:
The average body mass for each species was calculated after cleaning the data. I identified two rows (IDs 43 and 44) where the body mass was physically impossible (over 4 million grams), which exceeded the rule-defined maximum of 6,500g. These rows were excluded from the analysis.

Results:
- Adelie: 3,667.86 g
- Chinstrap: 3,726.67 g
- Gentoo: 5,228.33 g
